chapter: Tuba players and New Orleans bands
title: Dave Bailey and Minor Hall in the Crescent City band; Chip
summary: Barbarin recalls hearing Bailey and Minor Hall in a six-piece Crescent City band led by Chip, and learns Chip has died.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: Who did Dave play with in the old days when you heard him? Oh I played with different guys.

I remember he was with, what's the name of that band, I think it was Crescent City, Crescent City band, yeah. He was with that band for a while and that's the first time I heard Minor Hall play. Yeah he was with the band also, later on. Was that a brass band? No. No they was playing an advertisement, six pieces, Dixieland band.

No, not both of them together, no, I mean I heard Bailey with the same band and I thought he was a wonderful drummer. Who was the leader of the band? I think Chip was the leader at that time. Chip. You know Chip the trumpet player, he also played bass too. I think he's racking ball on Ramport Street, I don't know.
Yeah that's what Punch told me.
Well I didn't know he died.
Well we ought to check into that.

Yeah you should. You going to play that other record for me? Sure. Oh I want to hear that, Beaufort will be. All those jolly guys, man. All three of the bass players were into jolly. I had a lot of fun with all of them.
